B2B SaaS · File import

How to integrate WeTransform
into a B2B SaaS application?

Your customers send files in every format (CSV, Excel, PDF, XML, JSON), your system expects clean, structured data. WeTransform automates mapping, normalisation and validation with AI. I take care of the full integration: embed, rule configuration, custom Power Functions and connections to your systems.

Discuss my project → Frequently asked questions

The concrete problem

Why building your own file parser is rarely the right call

CSV, Excel, PDF, XML, JSON: every customer sends their own format, their own columns, their own approximations. Building a parser that covers every real case takes weeks, and every new customer reopens the work.

I spent 7 years at Sellermania connecting heterogeneous supplier feeds (CSV, XML, API) to an e-commerce system. I know the classic pitfalls of customer imports: encodings, optional columns, duplicates, silent errors.

WeTransform solves the generic mapping and validation problem with AI. My role: configure the target correctly, write the business rules specific to your product, and connect everything to your systems.

My approach

How I handle the integration

1

Upstream connection

I connect your source systems: FTP, SFTP, URL polling, or a dedicated mailbox if your partners still send files by email.

2

Configuration & business rules

I define your target format (columns, types, constraints) and write your custom Power Functions: SIRET verification, address validation, CRM lookups, licence plate checks, or any other business API call.

3

Downstream handoff

I wire the WeTransform output to your ERP or backend via API or webhook, matching your internal data schema.

Method

Embed vs building it yourself

Embedding the SDK (@wetransform/core) or an iframe with a custom domain takes four lines of code. The value isn't in the technical integration, it's in getting the setup right from the start.

Building your own parser has a hidden cost: every new customer, every new format reopens the work. WeTransform pools that cost via AI, but it still needs to be configured by someone who knows both your product and the tool.

I handle everything end to end, in days rather than weeks.

Deliverable

What you receive

  • SDK or iframe embed configured in your product
  • Target format defined: columns, types, constraints, validation rules
  • Custom Power Functions for your business checks
  • Upstream connections configured (FTP, SFTP, polling, email)
  • Downstream handoff to your ERP or backend via API or webhook
  • Configuration documentation for your team
Timeline: scaled to the complexity of your target format, defined together from the first call.
